name: MG Chemicals
summary: Burlington, Ontario electronics-chemicals company with a side line of 3D-printing filament (PLA with glow, thermochromic and wood variants, and PETG; ABS discontinued), sold mainly through electronics distributors such as DigiKey and Mouser. The extruder is not named.

product_lines.name: Thermochromic PLA
product_lines.notes: Older variant; no thermochromic id exists.

product_lines.name: ABS
product_lines.notes: Discontinued; was listed as unavailable in EU/UK.

additional_notes: Address 1210 Corporate Drive, Burlington, ON L7L 5R6. Sold via DigiKey, Mouser, Amazon and Lee's Electronic; the deal tracker currently shows no MG Chemicals listings. The site says only 'manufactured under strict quality control', so it may use a contract extruder, but nothing confirms that and no relationship is recorded.

provenance.conflicts: Manufacturing location not stated by the company; omitted.
